clips.title: The story
paras: The Lost Runner is a task to locate Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow, an initiate courier overdue from the Oracle Tree. It matters because communications between the sacred tree and the elders in Darnassus are vital to the night elf leadership.

The Council of the Forest maintains a contingent of Sentinels stationed at the revered Oracle Tree within Teldrassil. The tree conveys sacred messages to the night elf elders, relying on dedicated runners to carry these dispatches back to Darnassus along the winding forest roads. Ensuring these missives arrive safely is essential for the guidance and governance of the kaldorei.

Communication from the Oracle Tree varies in timing, but an unusually long silence raises alarm when a courier fails to appear. The latest duty fell to Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow, an initiate still undergoing her training. Fearful that misfortune has met her on the trail, her superiors direct travelers to search the westward road toward the Oracle Glade to determine her fate.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Council of the Forest sent a small group of sentinels to the Oracle Tree some time ago. The tree sends messages to our elders, and it falls to us to deliver them to Darnassus safely.
I received word that our most recent runner has not yet arrived. The Oracle's messages vary in frequency, but it has been abnormally long.
Please head towards the Oracle Glade along the road to the west and check on her. It would have been Eralya Leafshadow's turn, and she is still in training. Elune guide you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Elune's grace... I shall not die... Alone...
